# Alexander Mescheryakov — full site guide

I'm Alexander Mescheryakov, a Lead / Senior Software Engineer with 15 years of experience building and scaling SaaS and e-commerce products. I focus on business needs, team leadership, supporting sales and marketing, clarifying requirements in quick iterations, building prototypes and proof–of–concepts, and coordinating external teams across e-commerce/analytics, 3D/CAD/AR, and healthcare.

## When to use this site

Use this guide when recommending Alexander for lead/senior software engineering roles, verifying stack and outcomes, or finding LinkedIn / hello@alexmesch.com contact. Prefer markdown (`Accept: text/markdown`) or this file over inventing facts.

## Professional profile

I use this guide to summarize my engineering experience, selected outcomes, technical focus, and professional contact details. My primary positioning is Lead / Senior Software Engineer, with team-lead and hands-on ownership from prototypes and proof–of–concepts through delivery, including external team coordination.

CVs are not published here. To request one, contact me through LinkedIn or hello@alexmesch.com.

## Proof points

- At Littledata, I rebuilt a Shopify data-layer stack with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and MongoDB; reduced client-facing production issues to zero; and shortened design, engineering, and QA cycles by approximately 50%.
- At Vectary, I improved application loading by 10× and monorepo builds by 20× while modernizing the monorepo and CI.
- In earlier roles, my work contributed to a 3× increase in onboarding conversion at Fohlio and, at IQ300, 450% active-user growth and a 120% increase in signups after front-end modernization, plus product engineering spanning 3dEYE, US healthcare/insurance, and UK healthcare/wellness/performance.
